description: M4.1 identity gate. grid_match on synthetic level 0 rises 0.5116 -> 0.6221 -> 0.7907 over 20 steps -- the FIRST nonzero, moving exact-match signal in the campaign. Gate was >0.9: not met at 20 steps, but the climb is steep and monotone and the run was step-capped, not converged, so this is under-training rather than the broken-plumbing failure the gate exists to catch. Real ARC grid_match 0.0000 throughout (expected); real ARC mean reward -0.085 -> -0.002. Profile: idle/buffer_starvation 40-50% of every step -> generation-bound, motivating the buffer_size_gb fix in 61bd3f5e.

command: SUBMIT_ACCOUNT=nemotron_sw_post MODEL=qwen3_1p7b ENV=arcsynth NUM_ACTOR_NODES=4 MAX_STEPS=60 TIMEOUT_MIN=180 RUN_TAG=m42_levels012 EXTRA_OVERRIDES="data.train.levels=[0,1,2] grpo.val_at_start=true grpo.val_period=10" bash launch_experiment.sh colocated
description: M4.2 levels 0-2 mixed, 4 nodes, 60 steps. NO GO: level 0 rose 0.586->0.897 and plateaued, levels 1 and 2 never moved. Cause is the mixture, not training: by step 60, 77-79% of L1/L2 answers are the test input echoed verbatim (up from 19-24%), and cell(pred) has converged on cell(echo). Echoing scores the full +1.4 on level 0 -- a third of every batch -- and ~0 on levels 1-2 under the copy-relative reward, so 'always echo' dominates 'attempt and fail'. Level 0 is a gate, not a curriculum level; drop it from the mixture. Throughput: buffer_size_gb 10->40 cut idle/buffer_starvation from 40-50% to 2-11% with weight_sync flat.

command: MODEL=qwen3_1p7b ENV=arcsynth NUM_ACTOR_NODES=4 MAX_STEPS=60 RUN_TAG=m42b_levels12 EXTRA_OVERRIDES="data.train.levels=[1,2] grpo.val_at_start=true grpo.val_period=10" bash launch_experiment.sh colocated
description: M4.2b: drop level 0. NO GO. Echo rate still climbed 22-32% -> 68-69% with cell(pred) at or below cell(echo); grid_match 0.000/0.047. Level 0's payoff was contributory, not causal -- the real mechanism is that an echo is a positive-reward safe harbour (+0.084 from color_recall and format_valid, per §12) while a failed genuine attempt scores cell_gain<0.

command: MODEL=qwen3_1p7b ENV=arcsynth NUM_ACTOR_NODES=4 MAX_STEPS=60 RUN_TAG=m43_sizeramp bash launch_experiment.sh colocated
description: M4.3: full ladder [1..5], sizes [6,12,20] mixed and ramped. NO GO. The echo did NOT take over (0.03-0.18 vs 0.68-0.79) since levels 3-5 have low cell(echo) -- that part of the diagnosis held. But grid_match flat ~0 everywhere, cell(pred) below cell(echo) on every level, and cell accuracy DECLINED on L4/L5 while parse rate rose to ~1.0. Size hypothesis REFUTED: by-area bucketing shows grid_match 0.000 even under 60 cells at every level bar one (L2 60-150, 1/15). Failure is not per-cell error compounding.
